page.title: Billing
page.subtitle: What you have spent, what it is being spent on, and what your invoice is expected to be. Estimated charges update automatically.
page.noOpenPeriod: No billing period is open at the moment. Your next period opens as soon as there is usage to record.

usage.todaySubtitle: Estimated charges for usage recorded so far today.
usage.periodSubtitle: Day {{elapsed}} of {{total}}. Estimated charges, not an invoice.
usage.periodEmpty: No usage recorded in this period yet.
usage.periodTableAriaLabel: This period's estimated charges by metric

projection.title: Projected invoice
projection.daysMeasured: Based on {{measured}} complete day(s) · day {{elapsed}} of {{total}}
projection.actualToDate: Recorded so far: {{actual}} · average per day: {{average}}
projection.unavailable: A projection is not available yet.
projection.fellBackDetail: {{requested}} needs 7 complete days in this period. Until then the projection uses {{used}}.
projection.estimateDisclaimer: A projection is an estimate based on your usage so far. Your invoice is calculated from actual usage when the period closes.

explanation.rolling_7_day: The average of the last 7 complete days, applied to the days remaining. Recent enough to follow a change in your usage, long enough to absorb quieter weekends. Today is excluded because it is not finished.
explanation.daily_average: The average of every complete day in this period so far, applied to the days remaining. Today is excluded because it is not finished.
explanation.linear_pace: Your spend so far divided by how much of the period has elapsed, including today, scaled to the whole period.

unavailableReason.no_complete_days: This billing period has no complete day yet. A projection will appear tomorrow.
unavailableReason.too_early: It is too early in the period for a projection to mean anything.
unavailableReason.no_usage: No chargeable usage has been recorded in this period yet.
unavailableReason.period_closed: This period has closed. Your invoice is the final figure.

chart.title: Daily cost
chart.subtitle: {{total}} estimated · {{start}} – {{end}}
chart.empty: No costs recorded in this period.

timeline.title: What happens next
timeline.empty: Nothing scheduled — no billing period is open.

detail.accruing: Charges shown are estimates until the period closes.
detail.period_closes: Usage is frozen and the invoice is generated.

payment.title: How you can pay
payment.arrangementHint: Contact us for payment details and we will record your payment.
payment.empty: No payment methods are configured for your country yet.

official.title: Issued invoices
official.subtitle: Everything above is an estimate from your recorded usage. The invoices below are the official documents and the only statement of what is owed.

invoices.title: Invoice history
invoices.subtitle: Issued invoices only. An invoice is a copy of the usage it bills and never changes after it is issued.

invoices.linesError: Those invoice lines could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
invoices.pdfFailed: That invoice could not be downloaded. Try again in a moment.

prices.title: Your rates
prices.subtitle: The prices behind every figure on this page, resolved by the same pricing engine that produces your invoice.

mix.title: Where your messages came from
